mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate trend consistently reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs for corporate expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month change < 0), or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as recession fears dominate equity pricing.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), labor market tightness accelerates wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend consistently reflects robust consumer demand and economic confidence, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST rises (3-month change > 0), or Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal broad economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate reduced consumer and business activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST falls and INDPRO falls, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%), aggressive Fed rate hikes suppress equity valuations through higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 6.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
